2805b91972cce2fd699457ded523431b.overview: Timid pharmacy student Bertrand has mixed feelings about his womanising friend Guillaume's new girlfriend, Suzanne, who financially supports her duplicitous lover.

2841b2b6e6a40b2f96481f72add6f3cf.overview: The eldest of three sisters protects their Fifth Avenue mansion from a developer she once married.
2841b2b6e6a40b2f96481f72add6f3cf.tagline: Another great novel... another Warner Bros. hit!

2845b29cfcb6347bb708b0d45079e96b.overview: Stranded on Mars with only a monkey as a companion, an astronaut must figure out how to find oxygen, water, and food and companionship on the lifeless planet.
2845b29cfcb6347bb708b0d45079e96b.tagline: One U.S. astronaut pitted against all the odds beyond this earth!

286267610428761a0982f34f1d62d226.overview: An American doctor and his wife, a former singing star, witness a murder while vacationing in Morocco, and are drawn into a twisting plot of international intrigue when their young son is kidnapped.
286267610428761a0982f34f1d62d226.tagline: A little knowledge can be a deadly thing!

28975978a3e7c678413dad40792c80ef.overview: Jessica and Karl, loving parents to Rhiannon, who after years of trying to add to their family are elated to adopt Gabby, an 8-year-old orphan born with personal challenges. Their ideas of a perfect family come into question when they discover that Gabby is a troubled little girl, and the family begins to believe things aren’t what they seem. As the unsettling behavior of their “child” worsens and lies are uncovered, cracks in the family dynamic form with Jessica becoming increasingly concerned that adopted daughter Gabby is a threat to their family.

28998751676a8aaad6db4d8093d5e1fc.overview: Raoul Duke and his attorney Dr. Gonzo drive a red convertible across the Mojave desert to Las Vegas with a suitcase full of drugs to cover a motorcycle race. As their consumption of drugs increases at an alarming rate, the stoned duo trash their hotel room and fear legal repercussions. Duke begins to drive back to L.A., but after an odd run-in with a cop, he returns to Sin City and continues his wild drug binge.
28998751676a8aaad6db4d8093d5e1fc.tagline: Buy the ticket, take the ride.

28b7f196346a7a1a24b5b52e0b3ce974.overview: In his New Jersey study, Richard Nixon retraces the missteps of his political career, attempting to absolve himself of responsibility for Watergate and lambasting President Gerald Ford's decision to pardon him. His monologue explores his personal life and describes his upbringing and his mother. A tape recorder, a gun and whiskey are his only companions during his entire monologue, which is tinged with the vitriol and paranoia that puzzled the public during his presidency.

28faa7ef072b39d8a92a9efc932abd77.overview: Sandra is a young woman who has only one weekend to convince her colleagues they must give up their bonuses in order for her to keep her job — not an easy task in this economy.
